OverqualificationSection.description:
Additive mode (default) preserves the tunable cost term. Cost-scaled mode
multiplies selection cost by the fixed core curve, bounded to 1..20; custom
threshold/doubling/base values are refused in that mode.

base.description: Starting penalty before it grows with excess reasoning quality. In additive mode only; use 0 or more. If omitted in additive mode, uses 0.05.
base.title: Starting penalty

doubling.description: Extra reasoning score needed to double the penalty. In additive mode only; use a number greater than 0. If omitted in additive mode, uses 10.
doubling.title: Extra reasoning score to double the penalty

mode.description: Add a fixed-scale penalty (`additive`) or multiply the estimated cost (`cost_scaled`).

threshold.description: How far the model's reasoning score may exceed the target before adding a penalty. In additive mode only; use 0 or more. If omitted in additive mode, uses 40.
threshold.title: Extra reasoning score allowed without penalty

RetentionSection.description:
How long the routing store keeps each history table, in whole days, and
how many decisions keep full scoring detail. The retention pass rereads
this block every minute. A value that is not a whole number keeps its
default and one below its minimum is raised to it, each with a warning, so
a bad value here never rejects the rest of the file.
